# Pinned schema input

Only five unmodified product-package/recipe schemas and their MIT license are
retained here. `source-lock.json` binds their original paths, Git blobs, byte
counts and SHA-256, plus the exact local source revision inspected for SDK and
lifecycle restrictions. No upstream runtime or scripts are copied or executed.

The pin is an observed local source identity, not a claim about current remote
`main` or `dev`. Launcher is optional background at its own exact revision.
Schema conformance does not qualify a live Setup integration, grant lifecycle
authority, ratify DiskEd's license, or authenticate a publisher.
